title: Get Context Request
description: Public request schema for the get_context workflow. Supports conversation_id, query, project, date_from, date_to and limit as defined by the current Make input boundary.

conversation_id.description: Exact archived conversation identifier used as the primary retrieval key.

project.description: Project filter. The workflow normalizes this value internally before matching against the stored project key.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of archived records to evaluate or return. The public input boundary accepts a maximum of 20.

date_from.description: Inclusive lower date bound. When date_from and date_to are equal, the workflow treats the request as an exact-date retrieval.

date_to.description: Inclusive upper date bound. When date_from and date_to are equal, the workflow treats the request as an exact-date retrieval.

query.description: Free-text retrieval filter applied to predefined searchable archive fields.
